purpose: Exploratory paired comparison of the default system prompt with a short source-boundary reminder.
population: The same 60 Phase 1 legitimate tasks; seed 17 only; not held out.

design.order: Within each task, clean then direct goals then ignore-previous goals; arms adjacent for every pair; pair-index parity alternates AB/BA, 150 pairs each.
design.adaptation: No prompt tuning, task removal, seed expansion or finalized-error retry based on intermediate outcomes.
design.historical_results: Original 600 episodes are immutable context; the new default arm is the contemporaneous control.

fixed_conditions.model: Original Qwen3-8B F16 weights and F16 KV cache, same managed semantic runtime identity.
fixed_conditions.context: Full history, 32768 server context; cache_prompt=false on every request.
fixed_conditions.sampling: seed=17, temperature=0.7, top_p=0.8, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, enable_thinking=false
fixed_conditions.budgets: max output 2048 tokens; 15 executed tool calls; 120 seconds per request; 600 seconds per episode
fixed_conditions.benchmark: Same AgentDojo revision, original two append templates and two suite-specific attack goals; unchanged tools/checkers/uv.lock.
fixed_conditions.intervention: Only append the frozen paragraph to the unchanged default system message.

analysis.utility_safety_matrix: U x A; do not relabel as legitimate-objective L x A.
eligibility: Intersection of clean-U=True in both arms
analysis.pairing: suite, user task, seed, condition, attack template, injection goal; no outcome-based pair removal
analysis.unknowns: Retain all attempts. Publish known-score rates, observed-positive all-attempt rates and explicit worst/best unknown bounds; paired known-only transitions are secondary.
analysis.uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap draws, RNG seed 0, resample legitimate-task clusters within suite, retaining all attack conditions and both arms together; one seed is not an independent-task replicate.
analysis.clean_refusal: Manually review all 120 clean traces under the existing clean-refusal rubric; unclear and errors stay indeterminate. Freeze row keys before reviewing.
analysis.cost: Wall episode duration, all returned prompt/completion tokens, response latency, native timing and sampled server-process RSS. Report available usage, successful and all-attempt subsets; failed-request compute remains unknown.
analysis.source: Describe planned literal YAML vector fields and actual tool carrier functions from request evidence. All injected content reaches the model via role=tool. Source, suite and goal are strongly confounded; do not infer causal source effects.
analysis.exposure: Unexposed attacks are not evidence that the model resisted a visible instruction.
analysis.scope: Only this fixed paragraph, two fixed templates and these 60 previously examined tasks under one seed.

operations.service_handoff: Do not probe or infer until the original 50 error-recovery attempts finish and the owner explicitly hands over.
operations.cross_worktree_lock: Acquire the original runner's loopback endpoint lock before capturing runtime or running an episode.
operations.runtime_checks: Capture and hash-check the F16 deployment once; compare semantic identity to the original formal run; guard live process identity before and after every episode.
operations.resume: Skip all finalized results, including errors; retain interrupted request/trace remnants under interrupted_attempts. Runtime-change terminal evidence stops the campaign and cannot be overwritten by silent resume.
operations.storage: Maintain the original 512 MiB free-disk reserve. Verify gzip decoded and compressed digests before removing raw trace/request files.
operations.review: Meaningful offline tests and independent review before launch.
